notes.content:
The first Content-Update for Desert Thunder: Strike Force has been released!

notes.title: New Feature-Update next week! Introducing difficulties!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

there will be a new feature update released next week. This will add the options the choose between several difficulties and change the map zoom.

You can choose between the difficulties:
- Low          (100% view distance, 100% Damage, 100% RPM)
- Medium    (125% view distance, 125% Damage, 110% RPM)
- High         (150% view distance, 150% Damage, 120% RPM)
- Very High (200% view distance, 200% Damage, 130% RPM)
[RPM = rounds per minute, the frequency at which a weapon can fire]

While Low is the current difficulty with (500m view distance, 5HP Damage, 150 RPM) and as you can see the very high difficulty mode is pretty devastating. To give you a better chance to compete against the AI, I added the binoculars with the last update. This allows you to spot enemys over larger distances and plan your attack. To support this even more you can now adjust the zoom of the map, to see marked enemys that are more far away.

 Options Menu Screenshot

Another addition to the game is a basic health system. From now on you can find medikits on all maps which will heal you back to 100%. The medikits are from start on marked on the minimap.

 Medikit 

What do you think about the new additions?

notes.title: Feature update v30319 released!
notes.content:
Exactly 1 week after the release, here is the first feature update for Desert Thunder: Strike Force!

Changelog:

- added binoculars (aktivate with 'B', zoom with mouse wheel)

More updates, features and content is coming soon!

notes.title: Update politic for Desert Thunder
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I want to give you some small informations about the update progress of Desert Thunder.

I'm planning to release more frequent updates/patches with small additions than just a big update all 2-3 month. Content Updates are planned to be released monthly (for free).

The first content update is planned for May 2016 and will introduce a new asset Theme (Urban/City) and a new Singleplayer City map.

A new Feature-Update is scheduled for next week, which will include the new implemented binocular, a reworked menu system that will support more customisation in the future and some minor bug fixes and improvements.

The main goal is to add more content and enhance the gameplay (AI) over the time with these updates.

The changelog for the upcoming update is released with the update itself.
